### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #18535 <!-- REMOVE this line if no issue to close -->

Problem Summary: in `optimize`, `sessVars.StmtCtx.StmtHints` will be overwrite in a defered function at returning, but if the executed statement is a prepared statement, the hint will be eclipsed, causeing the hint being invalid.

### What is changed and how it works?

issue_context.title: hint doesn't work in prepare stmt
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)
```
prepare stmt from "select /*+ max_execution_time(100) */ sleep(1)";
execute stmt;
select /*+ max_execution_time(100) */ sleep(1);
```
<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
in mysql  8.0.17
```
mysql> prepare stmt from "select /*+ max_execution_time(100) */ sleep(1)";
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.00 sec)
Statement prepared

mysql> execute stmt;
+----------+
| sleep(1) |
+----------+
|        1 |
+----------+
1 row in set (0.10 sec)

mysql> select /*+ max_execution_time(100) */ sleep(1);
+----------+
| sleep(1) |
+----------+
|        1 |
+----------+
1 row in set (0.10 sec)
```
### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
```
mysql> prepare stmt from "select /*+ max_execution_time(100) */ sleep(1)";
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.00 sec)

mysql> execute stmt;
select /*+ max_execution_time(100) */ sleep(1);
+----------+
| sleep(1) |
+----------+
|        0 |
+----------+
1 row in set (1.01 sec)

mysql> select /*+ max_execution_time(100) */ sleep(1);
+----------+
| sleep(1) |
+----------+
|        1 |
+----------+
1 row in set (0.16 sec)
```
